concerns.text: Task T009 is marked completed (`[X]`) but its dependency T012 (descriptor computation) is still pending. The dataset schema test therefore cannot validate a real dataset, weakening FR‑001 (data retrieval) and FR‑002 (descriptor generation).

Tasks T041 and T041_memory_assertion are marked completed while their prerequisite T015 (final dataset assembly) is still pending. This claims the pre‑processed CSV exists and meets memory limits, which is impossible without the dataset, thus weakening FR‑001/FR‑002.

SC‑002 requires the paired‑t‑test result to satisfy |R²_interpretable − R²_baseline| ≤ 0.05, yet no task or test asserts this bound. Existing tests only check that the t‑test output exists, so the acceptance criterion is dropped.

SC‑003 specifies a success condition of ≥ 60 % ranking accuracy on the top N external PCMs, but no task or contract test verifies this metric. The external‑validation tasks produce a report but never enforce the 60 % threshold, violating the acceptance criterion.

Task T006b (creation of `contracts/target_decision.schema.yaml`) is listed as pending, yet downstream tasks (e.g., T005c, T005c_run, T006b_schema_test) assume the schema exists. Absence of the schema prevents proper contract validation, weakening data‑hygiene and single‑source‑of‑truth requirements.

Task T013 (fetch literature PCM dataset) is marked completed, but its required output `data/external/literature_pcms_raw.csv` is missing. Subsequent tasks that depend on this file (e.g., mapping, external validation) cannot be fulfilled, weakening FR‑005 (independent physical validation).
